subject: general
question:
If mode of the following data is 14, then what is the value of k?

11, k, 8, 9, (k - 1), 11, 12, 12, 15, (k - 1), 14
solution:
**Given:**

The mode of the given data = 14

**Concept used:**

The mode of a data set that has a high frequency or appears more times.

**Calculation:**

In the data, the value (k - 1) comes 2 times and 14 comes one time.

According to the question, the 14 (mode) will appears most of the time.

After reviewing the data set, we can say if (k - 1) will be 14 then the 14 will come more times than other terms.

So, k - 1 = 14

⇒ k = 14 + 1 = 15

**∴ The value of k is 15**
